landing.title: Paper — Smart space for your thoughts
landing.subtitle: A next-generation minimalist notebook. Store notes, structure with folders and tags, and find everything instantly with full-text search.
landing.feat_search_desc: Powered full-text search finds documents in milliseconds as you type.
landing.feat_folders_desc: Group notes into folders and create tag clouds. Multi-selection in one click without redundant code.
landing.feat_privacy_desc: Isolated session storage. Monitor active devices and log out from old gadgets in one click.
landing.feat_markdown_desc: Write with pleasure in a beautiful Markdown editor. Quick card previews without page reloads.
